papers.title: The Human Side of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Business Model Innovation
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is growing in popularity, yet insights on its application to business model innovation (BMI) are scarce. Drawing on a qualitative, multiphase study involving interviews, focus groups, and digital diaries with strategy consultants, we explore how professionals engage with GenAI during BMI. Our findings suggest strategy professionals engage with GenAI through what we term reflexive augmentation, which represents the deliberate, critical engagement with GenAI to decide which tasks should and should not involve GenAI and which tasks to automate or augment through GenAI. We show how this process is shaped by four tensions related to trust, skills, value-add, and client disclosure. We offer actionable insights for managing human-AI collaboration, advancing BMI theory, and informing practice.
papers.summary_ja: GenAIをビジネスモデル・イノベーションに活用する戦略コンサルタントは「反省的拡張（reflexive augmentation）」という独自の人間-AI協働パターンを発展させており、信頼・スキル・付加価値・クライアント開示の4つのテンションがその実践を形成している。

papers.title: Organizational Adaptability: Synthesizing Emergent and Deliberate Innovation Processes Into an Evolutionary Model
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT This article develops an evolutionary model that synthesizes emergent and deliberate innovation processes to explain how organizational adaptability is constituted. Existing research on emergent innovation processes tends to view these as diametrically opposed to deliberate action, applying each attribute with little nuance and relying on an under-complex understanding of the interplay between evolutionary mechanisms. We translate insights from Niklas Luhmann's concept of adaptation processes and sociocultural theory of evolution into the organizational innovation management context to address these limitations. The resulting model systematically integrates distinct means-ends and end-means logics and identifies an intermediate third space where emergent dynamics prevail.
papers.summary_ja: 創発的イノベーションと意図的イノベーションを対立ではなく補完的関係として捉え直す進化モデルを提示し、組織の適応能力が「第三の空間」において両プロセスの統合によって構成されることを明らかにした。

papers.title: Governing complexity in sustainable innovation ecosystems: An empirical analysis for AI-enabled enterprise architecture
papers.abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into Enterprise Architecture (EA) offers transformative potential for advancing Sustainable Innovation Ecosystems (SIEs). However, AI's velocity often clashes with traditional, rigid governance. Using a sequential mixed-methods design – a systematic literature review followed by interviews with ten industry experts – this study maps AI's strategic impact across the EA-IE landscape. Our findings reveal that AI's value is primarily concentrated at the Business and Data layers, where it reconfigures ecosystem actors and processes. We uncover an EA paradox: while practitioners eschew formal frameworks as too rigid, they rely on architectural principles as dynamic capabilities to manage structural inertia.
papers.summary_ja: AIをエンタープライズ・アーキテクチャに統合することで持続可能なイノベーション・エコシステムを推進できる一方、「公式フレームワークを敬遠しながらも建築的原則をダイナミック・ケイパビリティとして活用する」というEAパラドックスが実務で生じていることを混合研究法で明らかにした。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence adoption and the demand for managerial expertise
papers.abstract: Research Summary This paper examines how firms' adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) relates to the demand for managers and managerial skills. Using a skills-based measure of AI adoption derived from Lightcast job postings, we show that firms with greater AI adoption post more managerial vacancies and a higher share of such vacancies than less intensive adopters. These relationships are strongest in manufacturing and among firms with higher research and development intensity. Greater AI adoption is also associated with shifts in managerial skill requirements toward interpersonal and growth-oriented skills, including stakeholder management, creativity, and sales management, and away from routine administrative skills such as budgeting, planning, staff management, and customer service.
papers.summary_ja: AI導入が進む企業ほどマネジャー職の求人が増加し、求められるスキルがルーティン管理からステークホルダー管理・創造性へシフトするという大規模実証結果は、AIが経営管理の高度化を促進することを示す。

papers.title: The twin transition: Driving sustainability through digital transformation in manufacturing
papers.abstract: In the context of increasing global competition and rising environmental and social demands, manufacturing companies are under pressure to pursue sustainable growth while maintaining competitiveness. Although the convergence of digitalization and sustainability—known as the twin transition—has gained significant attention, understanding how digital technologies concretely support sustainability initiatives remains fragmented. This study explores the role of digital transformation in advancing sustainable practices within the manufacturing sector, drawing on empirical evidence from an industrial cluster. The findings reveal that while digital tools offer significant potential for improving resource efficiency, reducing emissions, and supporting sustainable operations, companies face persistent barriers including organizational cultural inertia and investment uncertainty.
papers.summary_ja: 産業クラスターの実証データから、デジタル変革と持続可能性（ツインの移行）の統合が製造業の競争力向上に有効であることを示す一方、組織文化・投資の不確実性が実現を妨げる主要障壁であることを特定した。

papers.title: The twin transition puzzle: Can city governments align digital and sustainability paradigms?
papers.abstract: Cities are increasingly expected to harness the potential of the twin transition — the coupling of sustainability and digital transitions — to shape the speed and direction of socio-technical change. Yet, little is known about how the twin transition imperative is approached and acted upon by city governments and what internal capabilities and support structures they develop to align the twin transition. Drawing on 82 interviews and extensive document analysis across ten European cities, this study finds that the two transitions remain weakly integrated by city administrations. Our findings suggest that effective coupling requires not only comprehensive horizontal and vertical coordination but also the development of organizational capabilities tailored to the demands of the twin transition.
papers.summary_ja: 欧州10都市82件のインタビューに基づき、都市政府がデジタル移行と持続可能性移行を依然として弱く統合しているに過ぎず、効果的連携には水平・垂直調整能力と組織変革が必要と明らかにした。

papers.title: Orchestrating ecologies of transition intermediation: insights from a Dutch governmental policy program for urban transformation
papers.abstract: Transition intermediaries are increasingly understood not as independent agents but as operating within ecologies of intermediation that are embedded in the institutional contexts they seek to change. However, little is known about how such ecologies are orchestrated in practice. This study identifies a new dimension of ecology orchestration: the capacity to sustain institutional memory and share meta-knowledge across transitions. Ecology orchestration involves the aggregation of ongoing intermediation across multiple system levels. Policy and funding frameworks should acknowledge and invest in the capacities of ecology orchestration to accelerate sustainability transitions.
papers.summary_ja: オランダの都市変革政府プログラムを事例に、トランジション仲介機関が「エコロジー」として機能する際のオーケストレーション新次元（制度的記憶の維持とメタ知識の共有）を同定し、持続可能なトランジション加速への政策示唆を提示した。

papers.title: Digital innovation, capabilities, and organizational agility as drivers of firm performance under government support
papers.abstract: This study examines the interrelationships among digital innovation, digital capability, technological capability, organizational agility, and firm performance within the context of government support for innovation. Drawing on the resource-based view, knowledge-based view, and new institutional theory, the study develops and empirically tests an integrative framework using data from 300 manufacturing firms in Vietnam. Partial least squares structural equation modeling is employed to assess both direct and indirect pathways, and the results indicate that digital innovation promotes organizational agility, which in turn improves performance, thereby confirming a full mediating effect.
papers.summary_ja: ベトナム製造企業300社のデータをPLS-SEMで分析し、デジタル・イノベーションが組織アジリティを完全媒介変数として企業パフォーマンスを向上させることを実証した統合フレームワーク研究。

papers.title: Designing Participatory Systems Interventions for Behavioural Change: Integrating Soft Systems Methodology, the Theory of Planned Behavior, and Experiential Learning
papers.abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) operate within complex sociotechnical systems where behavioural change is shaped by interdependent cognitive, social and structural factors. This study examines a participatory systems intervention with food and beverage SMEs in a coastal tourism context in Vietnam. The intervention integrates Soft Systems Methodology, the Theory of Planned Behavior and LEGO SERIOUS PLAY, using single-use plastic reduction as a context for systemic learning and capability development. Thirty-six participants engaged in experiential, facilitated activities to articulate problem boundaries and co-create feasible change pathways. Pre- and post-intervention surveys assessed self-reported changes in attitudes, subjective norms, perceived behavioural control and intention to act.
papers.summary_ja: ソフト・システムズ方法論・計画的行動理論・LEGO SERIOUS PLAYを統合した参加型システム介入を食品・飲料SMEに実施し、行動変容の態度・規範・統制感を有意に改善できることを実証した。

papers.title: Business model prototyping and evaluation from an ecosystem perspective: an actor-based modeling framework for using system dynamics
papers.summary_ja: ビジネスモデルのプロトタイピングと評価にシステムダイナミクスを活用したアクターベースのモデリングフレームワークを提案し、エコシステム視点からビジネスモデルの複雑な相互依存性を可視化・検証するための新たな方法論を提示した。
